pageContent.heroTitle: Tiny Polymer Clay Friends for Your [Fridge & Keys]{color=pink wavy} ✨
pageContent.heroSubtitle: Welcome to the Weeble sanctuary! Each little critter is uniquely sculpted from high-grade polymer clay, hand-painted with pastel details, and baked to a durable finish.
pageContent.socialSubtitle: Watch our clay ASMR sculpting clips, packaging videos with cute stickers, and catch live restock alerts!
pageContent.catalogSubtitle: Each piece is individually sculpted, baked, and detailed by hand.
pageContent.footerCareBody:
- Durable baked polymer clay finish (do not soak or run through dishwasher).
- Clean gently with a soft microfiber cloth or damp wipe.
- Handle with love! Strong neodymium magnets are embedded securely.
